title: Vocabulary Day 01 · Omitted Headwords
sourceLabel: 提供PDF Vocabulary · PDF 2ページ／冊子380ページ · Day 01未移行5語（全60語）
verificationNote: Day 01は原本上60語です。既存移行で抜けていた左段末尾5語をスキャン原本と再照合して補いました。各語を文脈で判断できるmissing-letter exerciseへ編集しています。出版社の公式解答表は未収録ですが、正答は掲載headwordと一致します。

passages.genuine: The museum confirmed that the manuscript was gen____ rather than a modern copy.
passages.government: The national gov_______ introduced new safety standards for public buildings.
passages.habitat: Wetland restoration can protect the hab____ of many migratory birds.
passages.herd: A h___ of elephants moved toward the river during the dry season.
passages.illuminated: At night, the monument was illu_______ by rows of energy-efficient lamps.

questions.prompt: Day 01 vocabulary: complete gen____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: Genuine means real or authentic rather than copied or artificial. 正解：uine → genuine（真正の・本物の）。博物館が写本をmodern copyではないと確認した文脈です。

questions.prompt: Day 01 vocabulary: complete gov_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: Government is the institution or system that governs a country or community. 正解：ernment → government（政府・統治）。公共建築物の安全基準を導入する主体を表します。

questions.prompt: Day 01 vocabulary: complete hab____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: A habitat is the natural place where an organism lives. 正解：itat → habitat（生息地・生息環境）。湿地を復元して渡り鳥が暮らす場所を守る文脈です。

questions.prompt: Day 01 vocabulary: complete h___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: A herd is a group of animals of the same kind that live or move together. 正解：erd → herd（動物の群れ）。乾季にゾウの群れが川へ移動した場面です。

questions.prompt: Day 01 vocabulary: complete illu_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: Illuminated means lit or made visible with light. 正解：minated → illuminated（照らされた・照明された）。夜間に照明器具が記念碑を明るくした文脈です。
